context: A boss reviews a CSR-medical project
purpose: Teach: 腫瘍/叩か/舐め/湧き/たどる/明かし/白熱/惑わさ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 医療CSR、腫瘍検診支援、進めろ。
lines.en: Medical CSR, tumor-screening support—move on it.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Brief pause between clauses. Expectation of immediate understanding and action. No room for questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。批判で叩かれることも、覚悟しています。
lines.en: Yes. I understand we'll face criticism. I'm prepared for it.
lines.style: Steady, measured. Respectful but not deferential. Each clause lands with quiet certainty. Shows he's already thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Budget—don't play fast and loose. Be careful.
lines.style: Tight, warning edge. Hard stop after the dash. The word 'careful' is deliberate, not casual—this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員から、貢献の意欲、湧き上がってます。
lines.en: Yes. The staff—they're genuinely eager to contribute.
lines.style: Straightforward report. Slight lift of positivity on 'genuinely eager' without overdoing it. Professional but warm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去の支援例、たどる作業、若手に。
lines.en: Past support efforts—have the younger staff trace them.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact instruction. Pause at the dash. Delegates without micromanaging. Tone is neutral, purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。理念を明かして、透明性を示します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll lay out the principles clearly and show where we stand.
lines.style: Confident commitment. Measured pace. The promise sits quietly—not over-assured, but certain. Slight emphasis on 'clearly.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内議論、白熱した状態、出てきたな。
lines.en: Internal discussions have gotten quite heated.
lines.style: Observational, almost weighing the fact. Not disapproving—just noting what's happened. Slight tone of respect for the intensity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。SNSの誤情報に惑わさないよう、対応します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure the team doesn't get thrown off by misinformation on social media.
lines.style: Protective, grounded. Businesslike but with an undertone of 'I've got this.' Ends on a quiet note of resolve.
